description: This file is a comprehensive shell script used for automating end-to-end testing (smoke tests) on a macOS Parallels VM environment. It handles snapshot management, version verification, onboard procedures, gateway and dashboard validation, and optionally triggers Discord integration for notification or logging. The script orchestrates multiple phases of VM setup, application deployment, and health checks, with configurable options for modes, provider authentication, and test targets.
